messages:
kevin.m: Noticed a pricing promo tag (enterprise-uplift) was applied as a one-time discount instead of being amortized over the 6-month contract for OmniSoft. That caused this month's recognized revenue to be understated by $72,000. Need to reverse and reclass before close.

olivia.r: Invoice INV-2026-0314? Amount and recommended JE?

kevin.m: Yes INV-2026-0314. Promo = $72,000. Proposed JE to reverse current P&L impact and move to deferred vendor credit liability:
Dr Sales Discounts (6100) $72,000
  Cr Deferred Vendor Credit (2210) $72,000
Then amortize $12,000/mo over 6 months starting Apr.

zara.h: Do we issue a credit memo to customer or keep internal vendor credit? Contract says promo tied to support level and is refundable only as bill credits. So internal credit memo CM-2026-0099 should be created and applied when billing processes future invoices.

billing-bot: Ticket BILL-9458 opened by kevin.m referencing INV-2026-0314 and CM-2026-0099.

olivia.r: Approval needed? Threshold for VP sign-off is $50k. This is $72k so VP approval required.

vp-finance: I approve the JE and credit memo approach. Please attach billing ticket and contract excerpt to the JE.

kevin.m: I'll prepare the NetSuite JE and include BILL-9458, invoice export, and contract clause. Will update the revenue schedule and close pack note: "Reverse one-time application of enterprise promo on INV-2026-0314; record deferred vendor credit $72,000; amortize $12,000/month Apr-Sep; issue internal CM-2026-0099."

zara.h: Also recommend a billing rule change so promos with tag enterprise-uplift automatically generate a deferred vendor credit liability instead of invoice-level discount. I'll attach a policy change request to the BILL ticket.

kevin.m: Tagging olivia for JE posting once complete.

olivia.r: Will post JE after attachments and notify audit. Thanks.
